name: side-lying oblique crunch with bent-knee lift
description: A side-lying crunch that draws a bent knee toward the upper elbow, working the obliques.
instructions: Lie on one side and support yourself with the lower arm on the floor.
Place your upper hand lightly behind your head and bend your upper knee.
Curl your upper shoulder toward the bent knee as you lift the knee slightly.
Lower slowly, finish the reps and switch sides without pulling on your neck.
